# Extraction

One aspect of the code at one revision, as produced by an extractor on stdout. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/extraction/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/extraction/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/extraction/v0.json).

## Document

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `protocolVersion` | `0` | Yes |  |
| `schema` | [`domainSchema`](#domainschema) | Yes |  |
| `vocabularies` | array of [`vocabulary`](#vocabulary) |  | Vocabularies the extraction follows: typed conventions over its schema, such as `dependency-injection/v0` over `architecture/v0`. The engine checks their rules too. Items are unique. |
| `entities` | array of [`entity`](#entity) | Yes | At most 10000 items. |
| `relationships` | array of [`relationship`](#relationship) | Yes | At most 50000 items. |
| `volatile` | array of [`volatile`](#volatile) |  | Data that may vary between runs at the same revision, such as durations or measurements, and how much. Part of the digest. At most 256 items. |
| `missingInputs` | array of string |  | Declared inputs (repository-relative files, folders or globs) that don't exist at the examined revision. The extraction describes the revision without them, so a comparison shows their contents as added or removed, with a notice. Part of the digest. At most 256 items. Items are unique. |
| `metadata` | [`data`](#data) |  |  |

No other properties are allowed.

## Definitions

### `text`

Type: string. Pattern `\S`. At least 1 character.

### `number`

Type: number. At least -9007199254740991. At most 9007199254740991.

### `json`

Type: null or boolean or string or [`number`](#number) or array of [`json`](#json) or map of [`json`](#json).

### `data`

Type: map of [`json`](#json).

### `domainSchema`

Type: `"graph/v0"` or `"dag/v0"` or `"treemap/v0"` or `"metrics/v0"` or `"api/v0"` or `"database/v0"` or `"architecture/v0"`.

### `vocabulary`

Type: `"dependency-injection/v0"` or `"infrastructure/v0"` or `"runtime-policy/v0"` or `"agentic-workflows/v0"`.

### `confidence`

Type: `"authoritative"` or `"derived"` or `"inferred"`.

### `previousIds`

Type: array of [`text`](#text). Items are unique.

### `tolerance`

How much a numeric value may vary. Within when any declared bound holds; values that are not numbers on both sides are beyond.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `absolute` | number |  | Within when `\|after − before\| ≤ absolute`. At least 0. |
| `relative` | number |  | Within when `\|after − before\| ≤ relative × max(\|before\|, \|after\|)`. At least 0. |
| `spread` | string |  | A pointer under `/data/` into the same item naming the spread the extractor recorded, such as a standard deviation. Within when `\|after − before\| ≤ factor × √(spread_before² + spread_after²)`; a spread missing or not a finite nonnegative number on either side can't hold. Its `*` segments take the keys the path's `*` segments matched, in order. Pattern `^/data/([^~]\|~[01])*$`. At most 1024 characters. |
| `factor` | number |  | Scales the spread bound; defaults to 1. Requires `spread`. At least 0. |

No other properties are allowed.

Further rules depend on these values; see the JSON Schema for them.

### `volatile`

Values that may vary between runs at one revision. Without a tolerance any difference is expected variation; with one, only numbers within it are; a generated value is judged by its basis. A pair's declarations from both sides combine, the tighter winning.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collection` | `"entities"` or `"relationships"` |  | Defaults to `entities`. |
| `kinds` | array of [`text`](#text) |  | The kinds it applies to; absent for every kind. At least 1 item. Items are unique. |
| `path` | string | Yes | A JSON pointer under `/data/`, with RFC 6901 escapes; a `*` segment matches any object key or array index, so a key that is literally `*` cannot be addressed. Pattern `^/data/([^~]\|~[01])*$`. At most 1024 characters. |
| `tolerance` | [`tolerance`](#tolerance) |  |  |
| `generated` | `true` |  | A generated value, such as a summary a language model wrote: judged by its `basis`, not its wording. Requires `basis`; has no `tolerance`. |
| `basis` | string |  | A pointer under `/data/` into the same item naming the generated value's basis: an object of 1 to 16 named parts (`input`, `prompt`, `model`, ...), each a nonempty string of at most 256 bytes. Equal bases make any rewording expected variation; a changed part makes a change. Its `*` segments take the keys the path's `*` segments matched, in order, and it can't be volatile itself. Pattern `^/data/([^~]\|~[01])*$`. At most 1024 characters. |

No other properties are allowed.

Further rules depend on these values; see the JSON Schema for them.
